cloud_enabled.description: Off-switch for every cloud call. Labels and translations stay on the laptop when false.

max_labels.description: Most page labels sent to a model when explaining a page.

languages.description: Languages a saved path is translated into (ne = Nepali, hi = Hindi).

cloud_model.description: Cloud model name. Empty means the app's built-in default. Only Gemini 3 names are accepted; anything else is ignored.

tts_model.description: Text-to-speech model name for the read-aloud voice. Empty means the built-in default. Only Gemini 3 text-to-speech names are accepted.
